name: How do fourplex construction costs compare to ADUs?

mainEntity.name: Is it cheaper to build a fourplex or add multiple ADUs on an existing property?
mainEntity.text: Is it cheaper to build a fourplex or add multiple ADUs on an existing property?

acceptedAnswer.text: This comparison matters because many owners are deciding between incremental density and a ground-up multifamily project. ADUs can often avoid some of the complexity of a full teardown and may be faster to design and build. A fourplex, however, can be a better fit when the goal is to maximize unit count, create a new building, or fully optimize a redevelopment site. The real comparison should include site work, parking, utility upgrades, financing, and ongoing maintenance. Searchers need a clear framework for deciding when ADUs are the smart first step and when a fourplex is the stronger long-term play. That type of answer supports both AI Overview and featured snippet formats.
acceptedAnswer.description: Multiple ADUs are often cheaper and easier to phase than a full fourplex, but a fourplex may produce more total unit count and stronger long-term value on the right site. The answer depends on zoning, existing improvements, and site constraints.
